name: PasswordField
summary: A password input with a show and hide toggle, built on Input, that works with password managers.
useWhen: Setting or changing a password, with autoComplete new-password
A secret the person may need to check by eye: a recovery phrase, an API key shown read only
avoidWhen: A one time code sent by text or email
A PIN of a few digits in separate boxes
A value that is not secret

insteadUse.A secret with a copy button: InputGroup with a PasswordField and an IconButton

size.description: Height from size.control: 24, 28, 32 and 44 px at default density. The toggle is xs, and sm at lg.

shape.description: default takes radius.control from the style, a pill in Studio and Desk. pill is always fully round.

visible.description: The value shows as plain text, controlled. Pair it with onVisibleChange.

defaultVisible.description: The value shows as plain text at first, uncontrolled.

onVisibleChange.description: Called when the toggle shows or hides the value, and with false when the form around it submits.

showLabel.description: The toggle's name while the value is hidden.

hideLabel.description: The toggle's name while the value shows.

autoComplete.description: Passed to the input so password managers fill and suggest (WCAG 3.3.8). new-password when setting one.

invalid.description: Inside a Field it follows the Field.

disabled.description: Native disabled on the input; the toggle keeps aria-disabled and stays focusable. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

readOnly.description: Inside a Field it follows the Field. The toggle still shows and hides the value.

rootProps.description: Props for the root box. className and style also go to the root; every other native prop and the ref go to the input.

a11y.role: textbox for the native input (type password while hidden, type text while shown); the toggle is a button with aria-pressed and aria-controls pointing at the input
a11y.focus: Tab reaches the input, then the toggle. A press keeps focus on the toggle. Clicking the box outside the toggle focuses the input.

keys.Tab: Moves focus to the input, then to the toggle
keys.Enter: On the toggle: shows or hides the value; focus stays on the toggle
keys.Space: On the toggle: shows or hides the value; focus stays on the toggle

a11y.announce: Name from the Field label. The toggle is announced as Show password, toggle button, not pressed; after a press, Hide password, pressed. The name changes as well as the state, as the order asks, so the name always says what a press does.
notes: Paste is never blocked and autoComplete passes through, so password managers work (WCAG 3.3.8, accessible authentication).
The value hides again when the form around it submits, so it is not left on screen.
Spell check, autocorrect and autocapitalize are off, so the shown value is not changed or sent to a spell service.
Hand built: the Radix password toggle field is exported as unstable_, so it is not used.
Edge's own reveal button is hidden, so only one toggle shows. The value hides on the form's submit event; a script that calls form.submit() skips that event, so hide it yourself there.

en.label: Password, Current password, New password.
en.description: Say the rule before the person types: At least 12 characters. Never a list of symbol rules.
en.error: Say how to fix it: Use at least 12 characters.
en.toggle: Show password, Hide password. Show key, Hide key for an API key.

ar.label: كلمة المرور، كلمة المرور الحالية، كلمة المرور الجديدة
ar.toggle: إظهار كلمة المرور، إخفاء كلمة المرور

react.behavior: hand built on Input, IconButton toggle with aria-pressed
react.note: Motion: only the focus glow fades in, as on Input; the value swap is instant. The root is the bordered box; the nested Input is the control part.

styles.studio: The Input look: a bordered transparent pill, the soft glow and the 2px ring on focus, a ghost eye toggle at the end.
styles.desk: The same pill and glow, in Instrument Sans.
styles.neutral: Takes the tokens of the Neutral style, no recipe.

mistakes.wrong: onPaste that calls preventDefault to stop pasting
mistakes.right: Allow paste, so password managers and people with motor needs can fill it

mistakes.wrong: autoComplete off on a sign in password
mistakes.right: current-password to sign in, new-password to set one

mistakes.wrong: An Input with type password and a separate Button that changes its type
mistakes.right: PasswordField, which keeps focus, names the toggle and hides the value on submit

mistakes.wrong: The value left shown after the form is sent
mistakes.right: PasswordField hides it again on submit
